text: You try to aggregate, as I was saying. The packets coming from the higher layers are merged, so they are chained one after the other. So you get the payload. This is essentially a payload coming from the higher layers, and you put it next to the payload that you receive after, and so on and so forth, so that you concatenate several multiple payloads coming from the higher layers. And then you consider this concatenation of higher layer payloads as your mark payload, okay, and use that. So this is clearly a simple technique. You assemble payloads and you make very large mark payloads. So that then for this very large mark payload, you add only one mark header, right? Because this is your new mark payload, so you can add one only one mark header for all of them. And you can do even more than that. That is before sending the mark packets to the physical layer. Right when you send the packets to the physical layer to be transmitted.
